summary.headline: Lydus and Masala on Astrological Lore
summary.text: Lydus traces astrological and astronomical lore from Zoroaster and Petosiris through Antigonus, Aristotle, Heliodorus, Asclation, Odapsos the Theban, Aigieus Polles, and Ptolemy, then turns to Etruscan and Latin interpreters. A work of Masala introduces the number and powers of books attributed to ancient sages and their disputed astronomical hypotheses.
